result.title: ECG-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Targeted Electrocardiogram Waveform Evolution
result.summary: Electrocardiogram (ECG) models need supervision that targets evolving weaknesses and remains faithful to waveform evidence. We introduce ECG-RSI, a recursive self-improvement framework combining verified waveform synthesis with feedback-guided intervention search. Signal remeasurement verifies waveform edits; construction errors guide generator repair, while learner errors motivate interventions compared on a separate selection set. Across seven benchmarks, three rounds raise Qwen3.5-35B-A3B's mean question-answering accuracy from 34.57% to 56.04% and mean classification F1 from 24.27 to 34.03. Across the retained trajectory, the preferred supervision shifts from direct reinforcement to confusion-focused contrasts. Continued feedback correction yields diminishing external gains. These results motivate separating error diagnosis from intervention selection and checking whether gains on the feedback set transfer to independent benchmarks.

AI.brief_summary: ECG-RSI 提出递归自我改进框架，把经验证的 ECG 波形合成与反馈引导的干预搜索结合：用信号重测量校验波形编辑，构造错误用于修复生成器，学习错误用于驱动干预，在七个基准上提升问答准确率与分类 F1，并观察到最优监督形式从直接强化转向针对混淆的对比。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「重测量校验合成证据、并把错误诊断与干预选择分离」的流程，可能可供核查 latent/视觉证据生成后的忠实性验证、监督形式选择与贡献分配问题；但对象是 1D 心电信号而非视觉输入，迁移线索需自行判断。
